summary.value: gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct is the latest model in the gte (General Text Embedding) model family. The model is built on Qwen2-1.5B LLM model and use the same training data and strategies as the gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct model.

value.title: Towards General Text Embeddings with Multi-stage Contrastive Learning
